why_refused: The switched value is a byte OFFSET 0..15 into the 16-byte MIDI message record the caller passes (MIDISEQ_ACTIVE_BUF_PTR 94x, MIDISEQ_SPARE_BUF_PTR 14x, (0xBCB4) 1x); every case is the same `ld xbc, N / add xwa, xbc / ld l, (xwa)` -- a compiled `switch(i) return p[i]` accessor. Several offsets have partial readings (field 0 = message command, index into SeqData_SubDispatch_Table when < 0x27; field 3 = transfer step, compared with 0/2/5/8/9/12/13/19/20 by MidiPkt_ArpExtHandler_A..M; field 4 = status/abort code; fields 12/13/14 = a 21-bit length in three 7-bit bytes), but others change meaning with the message type: field 11 is a voice index clamped by SysEx_ClampVoiceIndex128 in audio/dsp_config_sysex.s yet compared with 2 in MidiPkt_SysExBulkTransfer_Data; field 5 is compared with 0x7E/0x2D/0x2C/0x2B. The record is a union keyed by field 0, so an offset has no single meaning to name a case after, and the case bodies do nothing offset-specific. A name would only restate 'offset N'.
